subject.title: fix #93908: [Bug]: [Bug]: Feishu plugin skipping discovery - host reports 2026.5.28 despite 2026.6.8 install

question: Should post-core plugin update and convergence use the installed target package version as the compatibility host version before restart for both upgrades and downgrades?
rationale: The code path is a plausible root-cause fix, but it intentionally changes an upgrade-sensitive compatibility source of truth that can affect installed external plugin availability.

options.title: Accept installed-target host version
options.body: Merge the focused update-handoff fix and separately track the linked issue's later unknown-host runtime variant if it still reproduces.

options.title: Require broader runtime-version fix first
options.body: Pause this PR until the unknown-host systemd/global-npm variant is addressed in the same branch or a canonical companion PR.

options.title: Keep downgrade-only behavior
options.body: Reject this source-of-truth change and ask for a narrower diagnostic or runtime-version resolution path instead.

recommendation.title: Accept installed-target host version
recommendation.body: Merge the focused update-handoff fix and separately track the linked issue's later unknown-host runtime variant if it still reproduces.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent update and release-package history makes this the best available owner for the upgrade-compatibility source-of-truth choice.
